name: Vampiric Bat Lord
description: A massive, intelligent bat that has evolved the ability to drain life energy from its prey. Its wingspan casts a terrifying shadow across the cavern walls.

life_drain.description: Drains life energy, healing itself for the same amount

supersonic_wave.description: Emits a powerful sonic wave that causes disorientation and damage

bat_swarm.description: Calls a swarm of smaller bats to assist in battle

name: Plague Rat Alpha
description: The diseased leader of the cave rat packs. Its fur is matted with a glowing green substance, and pustules on its skin burst with toxic gas.

virulent_bite.description: A diseased bite that causes severe ongoing damage

plague_cloud.description: Releases a cloud of toxic spores that damage and reduce accuracy

rat_call.description: Calls lesser rats to join the fight

name: Prismatic Crystal Weaver
description: A giant crystal spider whose body is composed of multicolored crystal segments. It can manipulate light and refract energy through its crystalline body.

elemental.description: Randomly uses fire, ice, or lightning damage

prismatic_beam.description: Focuses light through its body to create a powerful elemental beam

crystal_prison.description: Encases victims in crystal, preventing movement for longer

refraction.description: Bends light around its body, becoming difficult to target

name: Kobold Geomancer
description: A powerful kobold shaman who has learned to harness the magical energies of the crystals in the caverns. Wears elaborate crystal jewelry that amplifies its powers.

earth_spike.description: Causes sharp stone spikes to erupt from the ground

crystal_ward.description: Creates a protective barrier of crystal shards

stone_skin.description: Temporarily turns skin to stone, greatly increasing defense

name: Ancient Rockjaw
description: A colossal rock crawler that has lived for centuries in the deepest parts of the caverns. Its carapace has fused with various minerals, making it incredibly durable.

boulder_crush.description: A devastating attack that ignores a portion of armor

seismic_slam.description: Slams into the ground, causing a small earthquake that can stun

diamond_shell.description: Hardens its shell to an incredible degree, reducing all incoming damage

name: The Mycelium Mind
description: An enormous, sentient fungal colony that has developed a hive consciousness and absorbed the memories of its victims through spores that infect the brain.

memory_theft.description: Absorbs memories, causing mental damage and draining energy

hallucinogenic_spores.description: Releases spores that cause hallucinations and confusion

fungal_puppets.description: Animates fungal growths in the shape of previous victims

name: Crystallos, The Living Geode
description: A massive, sentient crystal formation that has absorbed magical energies over millennia. Its hollow center contains a swirling vortex of arcane energy that occasionally discharges with devastating effect.

crystal_nova.description: Releases a devastating burst of crystal shards in all directions

arcane_overload.description: Channels excess magical energy into a concentrated beam

crystal_regeneration.description: Rapidly grows new crystal formations to repair damage

crystal_reflection.description: Creates a crystalline mirror that reflects a portion of damage back to attacker
